opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of mines, plants and equipment over their productive lives — a non-cash charge.

opex.name: Reclamation & remediation
opex.note: Setting aside money to restore mine sites and clean up environmental obligations — higher than the usual run rate this quarter (it was $123M a year ago).

opex.name: Exploration & advanced projects
opex.note: Searching for new deposits ($68M) and developing future projects and research ($58M) — spending on the next generation of mines.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The head office and corporate functions.

opex.name: Impairments & other, net
opex.note: Small impairment charges ($2M) plus other operating expense, net ($16M).

footerNote: Net income is the $2,475M attributable to Newmont stockholders (the basis for the $2.35 EPS): consolidated net income was $2,514M, of which $39M belonged to noncontrolling interests (the Merian mine partner). The equity line therefore shows $104M — $143M of equity income from affiliates, less that $39M partner share. Revenue is split by metal, as Newmont reports it; 'costs applicable to sales' excludes depreciation and reclamation, which Newmont reports separately and which appear in running costs here.
otherDetail: Equity income from affiliates of $143M plus $78M of other income, less $31M of interest expense — and less the $39M of profit belonging to the Merian mine's outside partner — nets to $151M added below operating profit.

segments.name: Gold
segments.note: The core business: 1,211 thousand ounces sold at a net realized price of $4,317 an ounce. Revenue up 12% — the higher price more than made up for selling fewer ounces than a year ago (1,319 thousand).

segments.name: Silver
segments.note: Mostly a co-product of the Peñasquito mine in Mexico. Revenue up 88% on higher silver prices and volumes.

segments.name: Copper
segments.note: Copper from mines like Cadia and Peñasquito. Revenue down 10% on lower volumes, despite higher realized copper prices.

segments.name: Zinc
segments.note: Zinc, chiefly from Peñasquito. Revenue up 35% on stronger prices.

segments.name: Lead
segments.note: A small by-product stream, mainly from Peñasquito. Revenue down 25%.

takeaways.text: Newmont sold 1,211 thousand ounces of gold at a net realized $4,317 an ounce, so revenue rose 15% even though gold volumes fell 8% versus a year ago (1,319 thousand ounces).
takeaways.title: Price did the heavy lifting

takeaways.text: Net income attributable to Newmont rose to $2,475M ($2.35 a share) from $1,832M a year ago, helped by $113M less income and mining tax than the prior quarter on the company's own sequential walk.
takeaways.title: Profit followed the price

takeaways.text: Attributable gold production rose 1% from the second quarter to 1,302 thousand ounces as Cadia recovered from a seismic event and Brucejack improved — partly offset by planned maintenance at Lihir and Boddington.
takeaways.title: Production steadied

verdict: Sales rose 15% to $6.4B and profit hit $2.5B — a $4,317 realized gold price more than made up for selling fewer ounces.
